block.bloodandbones.shackle_hook.tooltip: PH: A hanging carcass keeps swinging and can be worked on from all sides.
PH: Click the hook again, or with an empty hand, to let it down.
PH: Hangs a carcass. Drag one up to it and click the hook with the Meat Hook to hang it by the limb you are holding.
bloodandbones.jei.cleaver.1: PH: The Cleaver takes a carcass apart. Right-click a limb three times to cut through the joint; the limb comes free as its own piece.
bloodandbones.jei.cleaver.2: PH: Severed limbs can still be hooked and dragged on their own. The body cannot be cut through, only its limbs.
bloodandbones.jei.meat_hook.1: PH: The Meat Hook is how carcasses enter the pipeline. Kill an animal with it and the whole body stays behind as a physics carcass instead of dropping loot.
bloodandbones.jei.meat_hook.2: PH: Right-click a limb to hook it and drag the carcass behind you. Heavier animals slow you down more. Right-click again to let go.
bloodandbones.jei.shackle_hook.1: PH: Mount the Shackle Hook under a ceiling or on a wall. Drag a carcass close and click the hook with the Meat Hook to hang it.
bloodandbones.jei.shackle_hook.2: PH: Hanging carcasses stay ragdolls, so they swing, and will be routable along chain conveyors.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_piece.tooltip: PH: Shift-right-click a head, a leg or a whole small animal with an empty hand to pick it up.
PH: A piece still attached to a body has to be cut off first.
PH: A piece of carcass light enough to carry. Right-click the ground to put it back down as a body.
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.behav: PH: The body itself cannot be cut through.
PH: A severed limb is its own piece: hook it, drag it, hang it.
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.summa: PH: Right-click a limb of a carcass to cut into it. Three cuts sever the joint and the limb comes off.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.beh: PH: Dragging slows you down. Heavier animals slow you more.
PH: Where you hook matters: the limb you grab is the one that gets pulled.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.sum: PH: Kill an animal with this and it leaves a whole carcass instead of loot. Right-click a carcass to drag it, right-click again to let go.
